title: Pesta: The sea Calls
author: Senior_Escape104
selftext: Im a month into my project. I am using claude and tripo3d with blender. The main character i aim to have true voice actor do. I hope youll find it interesting and Wanna follow my devlog on itch . Planned release late 2027 on steam and android. Even with the use of ai this will take many months and iterations to get to the quality i dream of. A costly project for one person. But its so fun. So much to learn. Im 55. And gaming has been a passion for 25 years. If you check it out id love to hear if you find the concept interesting.
